channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: India to build access-controlled ring roads, bypasses to curb urban congestion
item.description: The aim is to preserve highway speeds of 100-120 kmph, separate long-distance passenger and freight traffic from local movement, and prevent unregulated roadside development from eroding the benefits of public investment.

item.title: Malaysia Expects Tourism Fallout From Indonesia Haze
item.description: Australian tourist Cathy Hamilton was experiencing pangs of regret about her visit to Malaysia as she struggled to take pictures of the haze-shrouded Petronas Twin Towers.

item.title: America’s 5 greenest cities in 2026: 3 are in California; which one tops the list
item.description: The ranking assessed cities on factors such as greenhouse gas emissions per capita, air quality, green space, renewable electricity, water consumption, bicycle infrastructure, farmers’ markets and green job opportunities.

item.title: A 1930 law, 50% tariffs and a new lawsuit: Trump faces fresh challenge over Canada duties
item.description: The food import business that sued argues President Donald Trump lacked authority to invoke a never-before-used section of US law to order the levies against Canada and that this is part of a broader trend of illegal taxing actions by the administration.

item.title: Delhi airport traffic hits record first-half high with 38.5 million passengers, eyeing expansion
item.description: Delhi airport's passenger traffic has seen a rise first half of FY 2026-27 as per latest data provided by GMR Airports reported PTI. The IGIA airport recorded monthly passenger traffic of around 6.5 million on an average. Here's what we know about its master expansion plan.

item.title: Delhi AQI to slip into 'poor' category from Wednesday, pollution levels to rise
item.description: The city's air quality index (AQI) was recorded at 179 on Tuesday, placing it in the moderate category.

item.title: Marco Rubio in India: Can US biz diplomacy ease Trump tensions over tariffs, Russian oil and bring trade deal closer?
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s India visit puts trade and energy diplomacy in focus as Washington signals progress on a bilateral trade deal.

item.title: Michael Bloomberg backs Democrats with $80 million but remains wary of party’s leftward shift: Report
item.description: Bloomberg’s latest spending &nbsp;comes at a critical time for Democrats, who are particularly focused on flipping the House and securing a majority large enough to govern with greater flexibility.

item.title: US, India ‘very, very close’ to trade deal, says Rubio
item.description: US secretary of state Marco Rubio said the US and India are close to a trade agreement, with only a few issues remaining. During his visit, he highlighted India’s strategic partnership with the US and discussed energy cooperation.

item.title: Why did Saudi Arabia execute a Bangladeshi couple over an ‘obscene act’ at Mecca mosque? Why Dhaka is seeking answers
item.description: Saudi Arabia executed two Bangladeshi nationals on October 14 after a court convicted them of committing “indecent acts” inside a mosque in Mecca. Dhaka expressed disappointment over the lack of prior notification and is seeking an explanation from Riyadh.

item.title: JD Vance on 2028 presidential run: Why he says ‘there’s a chance’ he won’t contest
item.description: Vance’s comments suggest that family considerations could form part of his decision about whether to pursue the presidency, although he did not say they would prevent him from running.

item.title: Why is Centre reviewing National Mineral Policy, 2019? Critical minerals, recycling on agenda
item.description: The Ministry of Mines has decided to constitute a nine-member committee to examine the existing policy in view of recent developments and changing needs in the sector.

item.title: Britain to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthi drones and missiles, rules out offensive strikes
item.description: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said the fighter jets would conduct defensive counter-air operations to protect Saudi cities, civilian populations and critical national infrastructure from aerial attacks.

item.title: Why is UP election chief targeting duplicate voter entries ahead of 2027 polls? What ECI says
item.description: UP Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa has ordered officials to remove duplicate voter entries ahead of the 2027 Assembly polls. The move follows questions over multiple voter IDs issued to one person. The CEO’s office said deduplication is underway, with draft rolls due on November 12.

item.title: 10 years of UDAN: Scheme facilitates 1.72 crore passengers; government spends ₹5,091 crore
item.description: The scheme aims to make air travel more accessible by encouraging airlines to operate routes that may not initially be commercially viable.

item.title: Google Cloud services recover after London data centre power outage disrupts Revolut, Lloyds and HSBC
item.description: Google said the incident began at 0608 GMT and was caused by a power-related event at its cloud infrastructure. By 1210 GMT, most services had returned to normal, around six hours after the disruption began.

item.title: ‘Purpose of power is to serve': PM Modi invokes ‘Ram Rajya’ as good governance model at Delhi Dussehra celebrations
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi invoked Lord Ram’s ideals at Delhi’s Vijayadashami celebrations, describing ‘Ram Rajya’ as a model of governance based on justice, equality and public service. He called for self-reliance and unity, and said India had recovered over 650 ancient idols in 12 years.

item.title: US-Iran war: Who was Nicole Amor? JD Vance vows to work on ‘every failure’ linked to killing of US soldier - Details
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance said he would investigate concerns raised by Joey Amor, whose wife, Army Master Sergeant Nicole Amor, was killed in an Iranian drone strike in Kuwait. Joey questioned military preparedness and leadership, while Vance pledged to take ‘every single failure’ seriously.

item.title: With debt-burdened economy, Pakistan eyes Moon landing by 2035: Can China help make its space ambitions a reality?
item.description: Pakistan will send its first astronaut into space aboard a Chinese spacecraft on 25 November, highlighting Beijing’s growing influence over Islamabad’s space ambitions. With a Moon landing targeted for 2035, Pakistan faces questions over technological dependence and funding amid economic woes.

item.title: What is Daler Mehndi's net worth? Minister Subodh Uniyal claims singer got ₹35 lakh for Uttarakhand event amid row
item.description: Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi faced criticism after Uttarakhand minister Subodh Uniyal accused him of lip-syncing and appearing disoriented during a Navratri performance. The minister claimed that the singer was paid ₹35 lakh for the event.

item.title: SBI data leak claim: Hacker allegedly leaks 3.75 lakh records, 2,722 PDF documents; details remain unverified
item.description: If the dataset attributed to Siriusim is found to be genuine and contains sensitive customer records, the information could potentially be misused for impersonation, phishing, identity theft or attempts to obtain loans fraudulently.

item.title: Can Strait of Hormuz become ‘redundant’ in 5 years as Iran war drags on? Here are the alternate routes for Gulf states
item.description: The US-Iran war has exposed the Strait of Hormuz’s vulnerability, prompting Gulf nations to explore alternative oil routes. HSBC CEO Georges Elhedery says it could become “redundant” in five years. But can pipelines, ports and IMEC reduce dependence on the critical chokepoint?

item.title: Dasara gift: After bonus and festive money, pay scale revision confirmed on par with Coal India: Telangana Deputy CM
item.description: Pay scale of Singareni workers have been revised in an effort to on bring them par with Coal India. Check who is eligible and when will it come into effect.

item.title: Adani Foundation keen to partner with Gurudev Rakeshji's SRMD on grassroots projects: Gautam Adani
item.description: Gautam Adani said the Adani Foundation is interested in partnering with Shrimad Rajchandra Mission Dharampur on grassroots projects through its humanitarian arm, Shrimad Rajchandra Love and Care.&nbsp;

item.title: India a ‘refining superpower’: Marco Rubio lands in Mumbai, says US to discuss processing Venezuelan crude with Reliance
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio called India a “refining superpower”, saying Washington will discuss refining more Venezuelan crude with Reliance Industries. Rubio, on a three-day India visit, is expected to meet Mukesh Ambani in Jamnagar on Wednesday, with energy and trade ties in focus.

item.title: Ex-Cognizant, Info Edge HR professional quits Delhi job, moves to Goa: Why she left corporate life and what she does now
item.description: After leaving her HR career in Delhi, MBA graduate Arpita Sahu moved to Goa seeking a sense of home and purpose. She is sharing the emotional and financial uncertainty of starting over, as social media users offer mixed reactions and encouragement.

item.title: US suffers from dollar phobia, not Brics: South Africa envoy Anil Sooklal
item.description: Brics members are focusing on expanding local-currency trade and building their own payment infrastructure rather than pursuing a shared currency, South Africa's high commissioner to India, Anil Sooklal, said. He praised India's role in forging a unanimous Brics declaration

item.title: Dubai Luxury Home Sales Fall From Record Levels as War Drags On
item.description: Wealthy buyers from around the world continued to snap up Dubai luxury homes during the third quarter, according to researcher Knight Frank, although sales volumes declined about 17% from last year as the Iran war dragged on.

item.title: Delhi Traffic Police issues advisory ahead of Dussehra celebration: Check timings and affected roads
item.description: The restrictions may be enforced between 4:50 pm and 8 pm on the Urban Extension Road-II (UER-II), Dwarka Expressway and Road No. 224.

item.title: Vietnam Eyes Remote Work, Online Classes as Air Quality Worsens
item.description: Vietnam has proposed new measures to combat severe air pollution, including work-from-home arrangements for government employees and online classes for students when the highest-level red alert is issued, as it braces for another winter of worsening air quality.

item.title: Ousted Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina plans to return in December, admits she could be 'killed, arrested, or tortured'
item.description: Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return to Bangladesh in December despite fears of arrest, torture or death. Living in India since her ouster in August 2024, she thanked India for sheltering her. She faces a death sentence in Bangladesh, which has sought her extradition.

item.title: Mumbai airport Terminal 1 revamp: Why airlines are refusing to shift international flights to Navi Mumbai?
item.description: Airlines are resisting the proposed shift of international flights to Navi Mumbai, citing operational costs, slot allocation disputes and Mumbai airport's redevelopment plans.

item.title: Decoded: Why are data centres modern wartime targets? Ukraine hits Yandex, Russia targets Kyiv servers, Iran strikes AWS
item.description: Ukraine's strikes on Yandex and Iran's attacks on AWS expose the risks to AI infrastructure. Here's why data centres are vulnerable in modern warfare.

item.title: India-New Zealand FTA comes into effect: ‘Big day for Kiwi exporters’, lower tariffs — What's in the deal for New Delhi
item.description: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon announces that the historic Free Trade Agreement (FTA) between New Zealand and India officially came into effect on Tuesday (October 20).

item.title: JNU protest: Who is John Brittas? Why are university students on hunger strike for 17 days? What are their demands?
item.description: CPI(M) Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas sought President Draupadi Murmu's intervention as the hunger strike of Jawaharlal Nehru University students entered Day 17 on Monday.
